query: WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS (SELECT id FROM central.workflow_nodes WHERE id = $1::uuid UNION ALL SELECT n.id FROM central.workflow_nodes n JOIN subtree s ON n.parent_node_id = s.id ) SELECT a.node_id, a.id FROM central.session_attempts a WHERE a.node_id IN (SELECT id FROM subtree) AND a.state = ANY($2::text[])
